ev-account.intro.say: This shows your pack credits and lets you buy more.

ev-account.damaged.say: This machine's Evalation sign-in is damaged. Run /ev-activate and sign in with the same account as before.

ev-account.damaged-named.say: This machine's Evalation sign-in is damaged. Run /ev-activate and sign in with <email>.

ev-account.not-set-up.say: This machine isn't set up for Evalation yet. Run /ev-start to set it up.

ev-account.unreachable.say: Evalation couldn't be reached. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-account again.

ev-account.clock.say: This machine's clock is wrong. Set it to the right time, then run /ev-account again.

ev-account.refused.say: Evalation no longer accepts this machine. Email support@evalation.ai to sort it out.

ev-account.ended.say: This machine's access to Evalation has ended. To renew it, email support@evalation.ai.

ev-account.other.say: Evalation couldn't check this machine just now. Run /ev-account again in a few minutes.

ev-account.awaiting.say: Your request to use <whose> Evalation credits is waiting for <owner> to approve it.

ev-account.machine-awaiting.say: This machine is waiting for <owner> to approve it.

ev-account.machine-declined.say: <organisation> declined this machine. If that's a mistake, ask <owner>.

ev-account.declined.say: <organisation> declined your request to use its Evalation credits. If that's a mistake, ask <owner>.

ev-account.removed.say: <organisation> removed you, so you can't use its Evalation credits any more. If that's a mistake, ask <owner>.

ev-account.credits-unread.say: Your pack credits couldn't be read just now. Run /ev-account again in a minute.

ev-account.buy-ask.ask: Buy pack credits? They're <price> each, and you pay on Stripe's page. For another number, pick Other and type it.

ev-account.buy-ask-held.ask: You have <credits> pack credits. Buy more? They're <price> each, and you pay on Stripe's page. For another number, pick Other and type it.

ev-account.buy-ask-held-one.ask: You have one pack credit. Buy more? They're <price> each, and you pay on Stripe's page. For another number, pick Other and type it.

ev-account.buy-count-means.say: Opens Stripe's payment page for <count> pack credits.

ev-account.buy-talk-open.say: A run uses one pack credit for each pack it reads. What would you like to know?

ev-account.buy-opened.say: Stripe's payment page is open in your browser. Once you've paid, run /ev-account to see your new balance. If the page didn't open, go to <url>

ev-account.buy-open-yourself.say: Your browser didn't open. Pay on Stripe's page at <url>, then run /ev-account to see your new balance.

ev-account.buy-not-a-number.say: Type a whole number of pack credits, such as 10.

ev-account.buy-too-few.say: One payment has to be for at least <least> pack credits.

ev-account.buy-too-many.say: One payment can be for up to <most> pack credits.

ev-account.buy-no-price.say: Pack credits aren't on sale here yet.

ev-account.buy-unavailable.say: Evalation can't take payments just now. Run /ev-account again in a few minutes.

ev-account.buy-refused.say: Evalation couldn't open a payment page for your account, and nothing was charged. If it happens again, email support@evalation.ai.

ev-account.buy-unreachable.say: Evalation couldn't be reached. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-account again.

ev-account.buy-other.say: Evalation couldn't open a payment page just now, and nothing was charged. Run /ev-account again in a few minutes.
